notes.subject: ol man bilong khesed
notes.rationale: חסידים — ol man i stap wantaim khesed bilong Yahwe; 'saints' i tok bilong lain rot

notes.subject: katim olgeta
notes.rationale: נכרת: 'katim i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en' — pikinini bilong ol man rongus i lusim graun na nem

notes.subject: לעולם ... לעולם
notes.rationale: Ves 27 na 28 ol i ritim wankain tok 'לעולם' — man i stap gutpela olgeta taim, man nogut i katim

translation: Bilong wanem, Yahwe i laikim kot, na em i no ken lusim ⟨את⟩ ol man bilong khesed bilong en; ol i save gutpela olgeta taim, tasol pikinini bilong ol man rongus bai i katim olgeta.
